title: 第1章 我是男主还是路人甲第2章 转世灾年收徒
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:

正文开始：
……
“灭门之夜，跳崖得到神功，然后我穿越了？”
“这铁定是武侠世界！”
“我妥妥的武侠男主啊！”
陈默欣然接受了这个结果。
他可是熟读金大师所有武侠小说的人！
这开局，
妥妥的古早男主配置啊！
不出意外，
接下来他该神功大成，下山复仇，大杀四方。
最后抱得美人归，从此笑傲江湖！
“嘿嘿~”
“想想就激动。”
他痴笑低头看看手里那本从山洞里捡来的秘籍，《玄清功》。
封面古朴，
一看就是真货。

“妥了！”
陈默把秘籍往怀里一塞，爬上山崖，往村里走。
村子已经没了，
到处是烧焦的木头，横七竖八的躺着村民的尸体。
陈默开始刨坑，
挖了三天，
把能找着的尸首都埋了。
最后两座坟前，磕了三个头。
“爹，娘。”
“虽然我是刚穿过来的，但既然占了原主的身子，那你们就是我爹娘。”
“这仇，我替你们报。”
他站起来，信心十足。
“给我十年。”
“十年后，我提着仇人的头来祭拜你们。”
风吹过坟头，
几根野草晃了晃，
像是在回应。
陈默转身离开，背影挺拔。
江湖，
我来了！

……
十年后。
还是那两座坟。

Text begins:
…
"On the night when my family was destroyed, I jumped off a cliff to get magical powers, and then I traveled through time?"
"This is definitely the world of martial arts!"
"I am a perfect martial arts hero!"
Chen Mo happily accepted the result.
He is a familiar reader of all Master Jin’s martial arts novels!
This is the beginning,
A perfect configuration of an ancient male protagonist!
Not surprisingly,
Next, he should complete his magical skills, go down the mountain to take revenge, and kill everyone.
In the end, the beauty was brought home, and he has been proud of the world ever since!
"Hehe~"
"It makes me excited just thinking about it."
He smiled foolishly and looked down at the secret book he picked up from the cave, "Xuanqing Gong".
The cover is quaint,
It's genuine at first glance.
"It's done!"
Chen Mo stuffed the secret book into his arms, climbed up the cliff, and walked towards the village.
The village is gone,
There were charred wood everywhere, and the bodies of villagers were lying everywhere.
Chen Mo started digging a hole,
Digging for three days,
Bury all the corpses you can find.
In front of the last two graves, three heads were kowtowed.
"Dad, Mom."
"Although I just came here, since I have taken over the body of the original owner, you are my parents."
"I will avenge this for you."
He stood up, confident.
"Give me ten years."
"Ten years later, I will hold the head of my enemy to worship you."
The wind blows over the grave,
A few weeds swayed,
As if in response.
Chen Mo turned around and left, his back straight and straight.
Jianghu,
Here I come!
…
Ten years later.
The same two graves.
